annotations.title: Find real people to pray with, now or by name

description: Real doors to pray with other people: someone now, the Watch tonight, live tables, prayers left near you, hear the Kingdom pray, ask the family. Never promises anyone will answer. Example: {mode:"ask_the_family"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_people_to_pray_with. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

hours.description: For the_watch: 24 (the next day, default) or 168 (the week).

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

name.description: For pray_for_someone: the first name of the person to be prayed for; only personalises the answer.

radius_km.description: For prayers_near: radius in km, 0.1 to 50 (default 5).

time_zone.description: For the_watch: IANA time zone for local labels, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles".

want.description: For a_person_now: what they want a person for; picks the door handed over.
